verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes detailed API docs for the Document AI OCR/annotation/QnA endpoints with parameters, request formats (URL/base64/upload), and response schemas, and a runtime probe confirms the documented endpoint (api.mistral.ai/v1/ocr) is live and properly auth-gated. Community reports confirm real-world programmatic use (pricing, throughput, chunking behavior) validating it's driven via API in practice. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (all candidate paths 404) and up-to-date llms.txt links (stale, some 404), so machine-readable spec discovery is incomplete.
